questions.question: At which ground did Boland record their 'Largest Win by Runs' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Boland Park, Paarl — largest win by runs of 64, against Lions on 2015/03/29.

questions.question: Susan Benade set a database record (21/22 season, T20) with a value of 6. Which record is it?
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Most Maidens', held by Susan Benade.

questions.question: Who won CSA Women's Cricketer of the Year in the 2022/23 season?
Who has achieved the 50+ runs and 4+ wickets in a match double more times, Alyssa Erxleben or Alicia Smith?
questions.explanation: Alyssa Erxleben: 2 times. Alicia Smith: 1 times.

questions.question: In head-to-head List A meetings, who has the edge, Rhinos or Limpopo Lillies?
questions.explanation: Limpopo Lillies lead 12-8 across 23 meetings (List A).

questions.question: Who holds the record for 'Highest Individual Score' in the 24/25 season (List A)?
questions.explanation: Diedre van Rensburg holds it, with a total of 165.
